questions.explanation: Mineral particles provide structure, water is the medium for reactions, organic matter enhances fertility, and air allows root respiration.

questions.explanation: Lime and water have a neutral effect, while sulphur and salt increase acidity.

questions.question: Mark each statement True or False
statements: Soil organic matter improves soil structure and fertility
High clay content in soil makes it more fertile
questions.explanation: Soil organic matter improves structure and fertility; high clay content can lead to poor drainage; soil pH affects nutrient availability; soil compaction reduces water infiltration.

questions.question: Match each type of soil horizon to its description
right_items: Surface layer with decomposed organic matter
questions.explanation: O horizon is the surface layer with organic matter, A horizon is topsoil with organic matter, B horizon is subsoil with mineral accumulation, C horizon is partially weathered parent material.

questions.question: Sort each item into the correct category based on its role in soil erosion
questions.explanation: Cover crops and terracing prevent erosion, while deforestation and overgrazing cause erosion.

questions.question: Match each term to its correct definition related to soil morphology.
right_items: The relative proportions of sand, silt, and clay
The arrangement of soil particles into aggregates
The ability of soil to allow water to pass through
questions.explanation: Humus is decomposed organic matter, soil texture refers to particle size proportions, soil structure is the arrangement of aggregates, and soil permeability is water passage ability.

questions.question: Sort each item into the correct category related to the soil profile.
questions.explanation: Topsoil and organic material belong to Horizon A, while leached minerals and subsoil belong to Horizon B.
